title: Right Triangle Trigonometry with SOHCAHTOA
description: Sketch and label SAT right triangles, choose and solve exact sine, cosine, and tangent equations, manage degree and radian mode, and transfer trig ratios across similar triangles.

questions.stem_html: Triangle ABC is right at C. AB = 30 and \(\sin A=\frac{3}{5}\). What is BC?
questions.explanation_html: BC is opposite angle A and AB is the hypotenuse. Multiply the sine of A by 30.
questions.variation: Find an opposite side using sine

questions.stem_html: Triangle ABC is right at C. AC = 16 and \(\cos A=\frac{4}{5}\). What is AB?
questions.explanation_html: AC is adjacent to angle A and AB is the hypotenuse. Divide 16 by \(\frac{4}{5}\).
questions.variation: Solve for the hypotenuse using cosine

questions.stem_html: Triangle ABC is right at C. BC = 20 and \(\tan A=\frac{5}{12}\). What is AC?
questions.explanation_html: BC is opposite angle A and AC is adjacent. Divide 20 by the tangent \(\frac{5}{12}\).
questions.variation: Solve for the adjacent side using tangent

questions.stem_html: A ramp makes an angle of 17° with level ground and rises 8 feet. What is its horizontal run in feet? Round to the nearest tenth.
questions.explanation_html: The run is adjacent to the angle and the rise is opposite. In degree mode, evaluate 8 ÷ tan(17°) to obtain about 26.2 feet.
questions.variation: Solve for a length using a calculator in degree mode

questions.stem_html: An acute angle measures \(\frac{1}{5}\pi\) radians. What is its measure in degrees?
questions.explanation_html: Multiply the radian measure by 180/π. The angle measures \(36\)°.
questions.variation: Convert a given radian angle to degrees

questions.stem_html: Triangles ABC and DEF are similar, with A matching D, B matching E, and C matching F. Both C and F are right angles. In ABC, BC = 3 and AB = 5. In DEF, DE = 35. What is EF?
questions.explanation_html: The sine of angle A is 3/5 and equals the sine of D. EF is opposite D and DE is its hypotenuse, so EF = 3/5 × 35 = 21.
questions.variation: Transfer a trig ratio across similar right triangles
